definitions.explanation: A written expression that shows how a value is calculated, using numbers and operators. Used for arithmetic problems as well as formulas in spreadsheets.

examples.japanese: {計算式|けいさんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{計算式|けいさんしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っている→間違う：03036_machigau⟧。

{表計算|ひょうけいさん}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、セル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{計算式|けいさんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: In spreadsheet software, when you enter a formula in a cell the answer appears automatically.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧ (calculation) + {式|しき} (formula, expression). Refers to the written form of a calculation rather than the act of calculating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計算式|けいさんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up a calculation
- {計算式|けいさんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}する→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧: to enter a formula

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{数式|すうしき}→数式：16124_suushiki⟧: mathematical expression — broader, including algebraic formulas
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧: formula — an established formula such as a²+b²=c²
